name: Zij map
note: The map palette. Everything is a mix of Zij tokens (design/tokens.json) except two named map pigments. Rubric is never used by the base map: red ink means fire. Lapis is only ever used diluted, so MODIS marks still read on top.

verdigris.usage: Copper green, the pigment of cultivated land on old sheets. Fields, the river valley, oases. Never text.

ochre.usage: Yellow earth. Relief (drawn hills, range washes), the warm tint of land along a coast, desert stipple. Never text.

mix.note: Each colour is color-mix(in srgb, a, b amount%) — amount is the share of b. Tune these in the harness (Palette panel) and paste the export back here.
